notes: SFH371-5000, Feasibility of Residential Conservation: 50 Building Study, Western Addition Area Two (1962, dated on the cover label), read whole from 110-dpi page images. A photo album: 50 numbered prints, four to a page, each captioned with a dwelling-type class, the address and the block and lot; then the 15-building FHA Conservation Standards Sample repeated with the same captions. No text, ratings or findings of the study itself. People in the photographs are not transcribed.
